arguments.command:
cd /workspace && rm -rf /workspace/submission/__pycache__ /workspace/tmp/* 2>/dev/null; ls -la /workspace/tmp /workspace/submission; python3 -B /tmp/runcheck.py && echo "=== final native check ===" && g++ -O2 -std=c++17 /workspace/submission/engine.cpp -o /workspace/tmp/final && for f in examples/*.in.native; do /workspace/tmp/final < $f > /tmp/o.txt; python3 -c "
a=open('/tmp/o.txt').read().split(); b=open('${f/.in./.out.}').read().split()
print(('PASS' if a==b else 'FAIL'), '$(basename $f)')"; done; rm -f /workspace/tmp/final
